description_en: Retrieves a list of GTM 3.0 instances based on the specified parameters
description_zh: 根据传入参数获取GTM 3.0实例列表
kebab_example: aliyun alidns list-cloud-gtm-instances --accept-language en-US --client-token 1ae05db4-10e7-11ef-b126-00163e240000 --page-number 1 --page-size 20 --instance-id gtm-cn-jmp3qnw0000 --instance-name test --charge-type postpay/prepay --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListCloudGtmInstances

parameters.help_en:
The language of the response. Valid values:

zh-CN: Chinese.

en-US: English
parameters.help_zh:
返回值语言，取值：

zh-CN：中文。

en-US：英文
parameters.name: accept_language

parameters.help_en: A client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. Generate a unique value on the client. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The page number. The value starts from 1. The default value is 1
parameters.help_zh: 当前页数，起始值为1，默认为1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page. The maximum value is 100. The default value is 20
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时设置的每页行数，最大值100，默认为20
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The ID of the GTM instance
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the instance. This helps you identify the business purpose of the instance
parameters.help_zh: 实例名称，方便区分实例的业务用途
parameters.name: instance_name

CommodityCode.description_en:
The commodity code:

dns_gtm_public_cn: The commodity code for the China site (aliyun.com).

dns_gtm_public_intl: The commodity code for the international site (alibabacloud.com)
CommodityCode.description_zh:
商品编码：

dns_gtm_public_cn：中国站商品编码。

dns_gtm_public_intl：国际站商品编码

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the instance was created

CreateTimestamp.description_en: The UNIX timestamp that indicates when the instance was created

ExpireTime.description_en: The time when the instance expires

ExpireTimestamp.description_en: The UNIX timestamp that indicates when the instance expires

InstanceId.description_en: The ID of the GTM instance

MonitorTaskQuota.description_en: The quota for health check tasks

MonthlyEmailUsed.description_en: The number of emails sent in the current month

MonthlySmsQuota.description_en: The monthly quota for text messages. Text messages are supported only on the China site (aliyun.com)
MonthlySmsQuota.description_zh: 短息配额，仅中国站支持短消息，国际站不支持短消息

MonthlySmsUsed.description_en: The number of text messages sent in the current month. Text messages are supported only on the China site (aliyun.com)
MonthlySmsUsed.description_zh: 当月短信发送量，仅中国站支持短信，国际站不支持短信

MonthlyWebhookUsed.description_en: The number of webhook notifications sent in the current month

ScheduleDomainName.description_en: The access domain name of GTM. The domain name is a combination of the host record (the value of the ScheduleHostname parameter) and the primary domain or subdomain (the value of the ScheduleZoneName parameter)
ScheduleDomainName.description_zh: GTM接入域名。格式为接入域名主机记录（ScheduleHostname参数值）+主域或子域（ScheduleZoneName参数值）

UpdateTime.description_en: The time when the instance was last modified
UpdateTime.description_zh: 实例最后一次修改时间

UpdateTimestamp.description_en: The UNIX timestamp that indicates when the instance was last modified
UpdateTimestamp.description_zh: 实例最后一次修改时间（时间戳）

VersionCode.description_en:
The edition of the GTM instance:

standard: Standard Edition

ultimate: Ultimate Edition
VersionCode.description_zh:
GTM实例版本：

standard：标准版

ultimate：旗舰版

PageNumber.description_en: The page number. The value starts from 1. The default value is 1
PageNumber.description_zh: 当前页数，起始值为1，默认为1

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries returned on each page. The maximum value is 100. The default value is 20
PageSize.description_zh: 分页查询时设置的每页行数，最大值100，默认为20

RequestId.description_en: The unique ID of the request
